nota: Coordinates of the sites in Epoch AI's 'AI data centers' tracker (Epoch gives addresses, not coordinates). Key = Epoch 'Name'. Estimated with OSM Nominatim geocoding of the Epoch address or town (non-US 2026-11-09, US 2026-11-10); precisione_km from the geocoding match type (building ~1 km, street ~2 km, town 5-8 km, city 15 km, county 40 km). If Epoch adds a site not listed here, the script reports it in 'errori' and leaves it off the map until a row is added. 'note' = context added by hand.
